notes.title: Dev blog #2
notes.content:
Hello all skillful hot pot cooks.
Hot pot game is currently under developing for full release!
Today, I share you two new unique items that you can use on full version.


[h1]New Unique Items[/h1]
[b]Vacuum Cleaner (without hose) and Balance[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/edb062f65b500dd22f8b8434cb8fae76a2744962.gif[/img]




[b][h3]Vacuum cleaner[/h3][/b]
This innovative vacuum cleaner has invented for controlling giant growth foods. Use it for shrinking target food size, but according to law of conservation of mass, lost mass transfers another food.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/a3c2571025bae35d468f5e937432eb58874f9461.gif[/img]




[b][h3]Balance[/h3][/b]
Balance is symbol of equality, commerce, finance and justice since ancient ages. In these days, some law courts, government agencies  uses balance images for showing authority.
In hot pot game, balance is just one of many cooking appliances.
The effect is really simple, equalize two foods area size.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964192/11c35b883e8304c1bace5e5ace5eee3c10812b1e.gif[/img]

tags.feature: This innovative vacuum cleaner has invented for controlling giant growth foods. Use it for shrinking target food size, but according to law of conservation of mass, lost mass transfers another food.
The effect is really simple, equalize two foods area size.

notes.title: Demo version Update
notes.content:
Hot pot game Demo version has been updated.

[list]
[*]Game has been overhauled.
[*]The pot has been changed to cozy one.
[*]The cook hat has been removed from the game. Click a cabinet to get items now.
[*]Added in-game tutorial.
[*]You can use a slingshot on Next foods.
[*]Changing food's size formula has been changed.
[*]Hammer formula has been changed to multiplicative from additive.
[*]Added new item Butterfly wing.
[*]Added new item TNT bomb.
[*]Some items visual has been changed.
[*]Combo bonus formula has been decreased.
[*]Platinum coins effect has been changed.
[*]More...
[/list]

tags.feature: The pot has been changed to cozy one.
The cook hat has been removed from the game. Click a cabinet to get items now.
You can use a slingshot on Next foods.

tags.balance_change: Changing food's size formula has been changed.
Hammer formula has been changed to multiplicative from additive.
Combo bonus formula has been decreased.
Platinum coins effect has been changed.
